This file guides Claude Code for TD Studios’ Next.js 15 website, synced with v0.app and deployed on Vercel.

Stack: Next.js 15.5.4 App Router, React ^18, strict TypeScript ^5, Supabase/PostgreSQL, Tailwind 3.4.17/PostCSS, Radix/shadcn New York RSC, pnpm 10.15.1, Geist, Lucide, Vercel Analytics, Vitest/jsdom, Playwright, OpenAI ChatKit, Resend, `jose` JWT. Routes include `app/`, `api/`, `contact/`, `chatkit/session/`, `intake/`, service routes, protected `clients/[client]/`, `[client]/signin/`, plus `components/`, `lib/`, `public/`, `styles/`, `tests/`.

Create `.env.local` in the project root; use `.env.local.example`: `RESEND_API_KEY`, `CONTACT_TO_EMAIL`, `OPENAI_API_KEY`, `SUPABASE_URL`, `SUPABASE_SERVICE_ROLE_KEY`, `NEXT_PUBLIC_SUPABASE_URL`, `NEXT_PUBLIC_SUPABASE_ANON_KEY`, `NEXT_PUBLIC_BUILD_TIME`, `JWT_SECRET` (minimum 32 characters), `CLIENT_{CLIENTSLUG}_PASSCODE`.

```bash
pnpm dev
pnpm serve
pnpm build
pnpm lint
pnpm typecheck
pnpm ci:verify
pnpm report:types
pnpm scan:secrets
pnpm scan:secrets:staged
pnpm test
pnpm test:watch
pnpm test:jest
npx playwright test
npx playwright test --ui
npx playwright test tests/mobile-layout.spec.ts
pnpm lh:routes
```

Vitest uses `vitest.config.ts`, `tests/setup.ts`, `*.spec.ts?(x)`, `@/`, globals, JSX/esbuild, and `passWithNoTests: false`; excludes `**/mobile-layout.spec.ts` and `**/playwright/**`. Playwright covers mobile layout/accessibility behavior. ESLint errors and TypeScript build errors are ignored during builds for deployment compatibility.

Use strict mode, ES2017, `noUncheckedIndexedAccess`, `noImplicitReturns`, `noFallthroughCasesInSwitch`, isolated modules, App Router plugin, and `@/*` root mapping. Use accessible luxury mobile-first dark/light design; `www.tdstudiosny.com` → `tdstudiosny.com` permanent 301 redirect. Track analytics and support A/B tests.

Contact uses Resend; ChatKit uses OpenAI sessions; Intake stores Supabase leads. JWT tokens are signed/verified with `jose` and `JWT_SECRET` (minimum 32 characters required). `/clients/[client]` requires valid JWT.

Auto-sync is v0.app → GitHub → Vercel. Major changes should use v0.app; consider sync implications for manual edits. Use `pnpm ci:verify` before commits. Pre-commit scans staged files.
